ctx.x: My father died July the 17th, 1922, and he died trying to help some college students to do something that they didn't know how to do. He was on his way to do something else and he said, "I'll show you how to do it," because they were earning their summer money so they could continue their education. And he elected to get up on a barge to try to show them how to do something and the mechanics failed in the machinery and it was like a plow, a piece of steel struck right into his back. When The lathe fell down into…
Where was that, Jo? What college was that?
